fact: Seer is described as a next generation prediction marketplace.
quote: Seer, a next generation prediction marketplace

fact: Users can create, trade, and farm predictions.
quote: Create, trade, and farm predictions like never before

fact: Users can design custom prediction markets on topics ranging from sports outcomes to political events.
quote: Design custom prediction markets on anything from sports outcomes to political events.

fact: Seer allows users to create four different types of Market.
quote: Seer allows you to create four different types of Market covering a wide range of possibilities.

fact: Trading involves buying and selling shares, monitoring real-time data, and making informed decisions.
quote: Buy and sell shares with ease, monitor real-time data, and make informed decisions seamlessly.

fact: Seer employs the Conditional Tokens framework to create and manage outcome tokens efficiently.
quote: Seer employs the Conditional Tokens framework to create and manage outcome tokens efficiently.

fact: Seer wraps ERC1155 outcome tokens into ERC20 tokens for smoother trading and DeFi integration.
quote: Seer wraps these ERC1155 outcome tokens into user-friendly ERC20 tokens, facilitating smoother trading and integration with existing DeFi protocols.

fact: Seer uses Kleros to resolve disputes that may arise when answering Reality.eth questions.
quote: Seer uses Kleros to resolve disputes that may arise when answering Reality.eth questions.

fact: Kleros functions as a decentralized arbiter that determines correct answers by applying rules to questions.
quote: It functions as a decentralized arbiter capable of determining the correct answer by applying a set of rules to questions ranging from simple to highly complex.

fact: Seer market categories include elections, sports, political forecasting, financial market predictions, event outcomes, crowdsourced intelligence, disaster and risk management, and insurance underwriting.
quote: Elections Sports Political Forecasting Financial Market Predictions Event Outcomes Crowdsourced Intelligence Disaster and Risk Management Insurance Underwriting

fact: Categorical markets allow selecting one out of multiple outcomes.
quote: Categorical Select one out of multiple outcomes.

fact: Multi Categorical markets are similar to categorical markets but allow selection of multiple outcomes.
quote: Multi Categorical Similar to categorical market but allowing selection of multiple outcomes.

fact: Scalar markets involve a numeric outcome within a specified range.
quote: Scalar Numeric outcome within a specified range.

fact: Multi Scalar markets involve a numeric outcome within a specified range.
quote: Multi Scalar Numeric outcome within a specified range.

fact: UI/footer navigation includes links to Seer App, Blog, Community, Docs, Documentation, and Images & Branding.
quote: Seer App Blog Community Docs Documentation Images & Branding

fact: Seer is live on mainnet at seer.pm.
quote: Seer is live on mainnet at seer.pm .

fact: The Introduction section is an extract of the Seer whitepaper explaining the reasoning behind the protocol.
quote: This section is an extract of the Seer whitepaper: the reasoning behind the protocol.

fact: The docs separate how to use the app from how to build on it.
quote: For how to use the app, see What is Seer ; for how to build on it, see the Developers tab.

fact: A prediction market is a market where participants can buy shares of future outcomes.
quote: A prediction market is a market where participants can buy shares of future outcomes.

fact: Shares can be redeemed for $1 if the event happens and $0 otherwise.
quote: A share can be redeemed for 1$ if the event happens (so after the election, a share of « Joe Biden » will be worth 1$ if Biden is re-elected, 0$ otherwise).

fact: Shares are tradable, for example as ERC20 tokens.
quote: Shares are tradable (for example in the form of ERC20 tokens)

fact: Looking at the price of a share can indicate the likelihood of an event happening.
quote: by looking at the price of a share we can know the likelihood of some event happening

fact: If Joe Biden shares trade at 0.60$, that implies a 60% probability of Biden being reelected.
quote: if « Joe Biden » shares trades at 0.60$, we can assign a 60% probability of Joe Biden being reelected

fact: Prediction markets can produce results equivalent or better than expert opinion or aggregation of estimates.
quote: prediction markets have been shown to produce results equivalent or better than alternatives like expert opinion or aggregation of estimates from multiple individuals

fact: Seer's goal includes creating a prediction market ecosystem to solve previous failures.
quote: How can we create a prediction market ecosystem solving those issues?

fact: App features include depositing collateral, creating markets, trading outcome tokens, and providing liquidity.
quote: Deposit collateral, create markets, trade outcome tokens and provide liquidity.

fact: Developers can build on Seer using Contracts, subgraph, HTTP API, and viem examples.
quote: Build on Seer Contracts, subgraph and the HTTP API, with viem examples for every flow.

fact: Documentation navigation includes Seer, Introduction to Seer, Whitepaper, Documentation, Developers.
quote: Navigation Seer Introduction to Seer Whitepaper Documentation Developers

fact: Documentation UI includes a search box with ⌘ K, GitHub link, and Open app buttons.
quote: Search... ⌘ K GitHub Open app Open app

fact: The documentation is built and hosted on Mintlify.
quote: This documentation is built and hosted on Mintlify, a developer documentation platform

fact: The tagline is 'Markets Know Better Than Experts'.
quote: Markets Know Better Than Experts

fact: The purpose is described as 'Market-based evaluation of governance decisions and milestones'.
quote: Market-based evaluation of governance decisions and milestones

fact: A list or table includes an 'Active Proposals' field.
quote: Active Proposals

fact: An empty state message says 'No organizations found'.
quote: No organizations found

fact: An empty state message says 'No companies available.'
quote: No companies available.
